Author: Hovercast contributors
Name: Hovercast
Description: Automatic friendly casting through native unit frames, with no spell lists or macros. Forwards friendly mouseover casts to the game without additional cast-permission checks. Includes modifier overrides, cast history and optional ground placement. Keeps your selected target and native action queue.
Punchline: Automatic friendly mouseover casting with no spell lists.
Changelog: Remove Hovercast cast-permission, recipient-category, range, line-of-sight and dead/alive checks that could block valid friendly casts. The normal game handler decides whether the cast succeeds. Remove the second validation pass for unit execution. Preserve captured queue recipients, modifiers and optional ground placement.

Author: wallawallaslytherin
Name: Gearset Organizer
Description: Preview and organize existing gearsets by role and job, with guarded sorting and undo. Works independently without companion plugins.
Changelog: Initial release: preview saved gearsets by role and job, sort with verified reference preservation, and undo the latest unchanged sort. Open with /gearsets. No companion plugin is required.

Author: Z-Lock contributors
Name: Z-Lock
Description: Lift 1 cm and lock inside player housing. Movement is blocked by default; optional horizontal movement is at your own risk. Unlocks automatically when the housing session ends.
Punchline: Lift 1 cm and stay still inside a house.
Changelog: Optional horizontal movement while height stays locked, off by default and reset on reload. Unlock before changing the toggle. Always show a larger bold red WARNING: Use at your own risk! Housing gates and the 1 cm lift remain. Movement gameplay and visual appearance still await in-game acceptance.

Author: Cam Control contributors
Name: Cam Control
Description: Adjust zoom distance, field of view, camera height and collision strictly inside houses. Automatically restores the camera outside housing, during combat and in duties. Open with /cam.
Punchline: Camera controls for house interiors only.
Changelog: Initial release: house-interior camera zoom, field of view, height and collision controls. Open with /cam.
